description.value:
The engineers at Soviet arms giant Techtronika are driven by two core metrics: firepower and reliability. A simple design means fewer opportunities for breakage or jamming. And when you're fighting a heavily-modified adversary, you need those high-caliber rounds to strike true – without risk of failure. Although Techtronika has not altered the Pozhar's design for decades, their sales have scarcely dipped. In fact, it has long remained a favorite among MaxTac's elite forces, which should say more about its merits than any ad campaign or user review ever could. The only knocks against it are its relatively poor ergonomic design and extremely powerful kick. Techtronika will not be liable for a user's shattered bones.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Handgun • Range: Short Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: If fired by a user without BODY 8+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Torn Muscle Critical Injury if they did not have it already. If fired in Autofire by a user without BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury if they did not have it already.

Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
